Here’s how it works:

They can initiate an exchange through our Returns Portal.
They'll need the Order Number and the Email used for the original purchase to start the process.
If the order is within 45 days of the original purchase date, they can choose a Refund, Store Credit, or Shop Now (Exchange). After 45 days, the Refund option is no longer available, but Store Credit or Shop Now (Exchange) are still options.
When they choose "Shop Now," they can pick any replacement item from our catalog. If the new item costs more, they'll just pay the difference. If it costs less, they'll get a refund for the difference.
Good news: if a discount was used on the original order, an equivalent discount will automatically apply to their replacement order!
The exchange process kicks off once their return package is scanned by the carrier and is In Transit.
